name: Two-sided bars
what: A title and two bar names above rows of paired bars: grey tracks grow out of the middle row by row, then a bright fill runs out of the middle of each track to its value and the row names fade in, on a dark page washed with the accent colour; then everything holds.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f1 two dots stand in the middle of the first row and grow outwards into grey tracks over 18 f (a quick S-curve), the next rows every ~9 f (f10, f18, f27); the title fades in f2-f15, the bar names f7-f20 and f18-f32; the fills grow out of the middle f30, f40, f50, f60 (18 f each, the same curve); the row names fade in f26, f50, f77, f101 (10 f each); then it holds to the end
